record.title: Persist effective provider identity and causal inputs
record.intent: Make deterministic provider/profile semantics reconstructable through contracts, history, currency and storage before activating required capabilities.
requirements: Persist exact effective profile and provider pins with separately typed validated identities; retain old empty-profile semantic contract and historical evidence meaning through explicit versioning.

The shared reducer evaluates the complete effective prerequisite graph and persists revision-aware contributed-input observations; transitive provider/input drift must remain visible until explicit review.

Providers contribute validation, prerequisite/readiness predicates and evidence requirements/verification, never lifecycle transitions. Missing, unpinned, mismatched or failed required providers fail closed.

Keep environment probes separate from deterministic evaluation; any probe result used for eligibility must be supplied as explicit bound evidence. No arbitrary runtime loader, network read or placeholder approval provider.
Optional unknown extensions remain losslessly preserved and inactive. Stateful legacy imports remain blocked until their exact preserving provider mapping is proved.
acceptance: Core and cold file-ledger conformance agree on effective contracts, observations, readiness, evidence validation, cycles and transitive currency, including provider drift and absence.
Provider code cannot bypass core identity, graph, lifecycle, acceptance or stale-revision checks; read/probe separation and exact opaque values are proved.
Existing historical contracts retain identities; new behavior passes JVM/native corpus and process parity.
